title: Members
intro: Members don't need an account. Only people who manage inventory get an invitation.
deactivated: The member has been set to inactive.
inactive_notice: This member is inactive. With an account, they can't open this club.
account_yes: This member has an account and can sign in.
account_no: This member has no account. That's normal: only people who manage inventory need one.
links_hint: A login link is valid for 15 minutes, a reset link for 24 hours. You never see or choose a password.
invite_needs_email: Add an email address first to invite this member to an account.
roles_need_account: Roles only take effect once this member has an account.
deactivate_hint: An inactive member stays in the history but can no longer open the club.
optional_fields_hint: Only the name is required. Fill in the rest only if the club really needs it.
email_hint: Needed to invite someone to an account.
notes_hint: Don't put sensitive personal information here.
errors.anonymized: This member has been anonymized and can no longer be changed.
errors.last_admin: The club must keep at least one active admin.
errors.has_account: This member already has an account.
errors.platform_account: Only platform admins can create links for this account.
errors.admin_role_only: Only a club admin can grant or revoke the admin role.
errors.escalation: You can't grant a role with permissions you don't have yourself.
